video_title: Perk Says Darryn Peterson's Ceiling Is KOBE And Q-Rich Wasn't Having It

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins compares Darryn Peterson's talent level to Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: His ceiling, skill-wise, his ability to be able to get buckets at all three levels, is like Kobe Bryant.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: His floor is Bradley Beal. His ceiling, skill-wise, his ability to be able to get buckets at all three levels, is like Kobe Bryant. I say that respectfully. I am not saying he is going to have a Kobe Bryant type career. I am talking about the talent level there. There is nothing that this man cannot do. You are not stopping this young man from getting any shot he wants to any spot that he wants to.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: But you are not the only one saying that, Perk. Everybody says that is his ceiling and everybody says that is his flow. Ain't nobody denying it.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye cautions against comparing young players to Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: We got to be careful throwing that around. Kobe, listen, and I don't have this is in no way disrespectful to nobody.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: We got to be careful throwing that around. Kobe, listen, and I don't have this is in no way disrespectful to nobody. I just can't, I played against the man for too long to just allow that to just be thrown out there. We can't just do that, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. We are not. Respectfully, let's just leave that comparison and that talk alone, bro. That come with way too much.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye and Kendrick Perkins discuss Darryn Peterson's long-term potential
quotes.excerpt: We could say, hey man, we just witnessed one of the most talented motherfuckers to ever play the game of basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I am saying his ceiling can be, when it is all said and done, we could say, hey man, we just witnessed one of the most talented motherfuckers to ever play the game of basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: And that is awesome. That is still, I am not saying the kid won't be amazing, but I am just saying, I just feel like that is a big that is a statement, my brother.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye evaluates the projected NBA draft order
quotes.excerpt: You got the Wizards taking AJ at one, Darren at two, Memphis Grizzlies going with Cameron Boozer at three.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: You have the Wizards taking AJ at one, Darren at two, Memphis Grizzlies going with Cameron Boozer at three, the Chicago Bulls with Caleb Wilson at four, the Clippers, Mikal Bridges Junior or Keaton Wagler at five, and then there is a couple of options at six.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brunson just changed the whole landscape of everything. Everybody went back to the draft. Hey, A-Cup better be somewhere in that top five. He should be the first point guard off that board. He showed to you in college. Come on, bro, this man was shooting 40 something from the three, 50 something from the field, and it ain't layups, it is mid-ranges, contested threes. He don't do no wasted dribbles, he gets to the basket.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye argues Jaylen Brunson's team success proves his value
quotes.excerpt: If you look at Jaylen Brunson team right and give James Harden when he was in Houston that team, he won a championship also.
quotes.quote: If you look at Jaylen Brunson team right and give James Harden when he was in Houston that team, he won a championship also, because you got better two-way guys. You are going to take an OG over who they three is. You are going to take Mikal Bridges over Trevor Ariza because he can score better and defend. You are going to take a Josh Hart over P.J.
